notes.title: Aladdin, Yoda and Rocket star in cancelled Disney Infinity 4.0 footage
notes.content:
Disney Infinity 4.0 was already in production when the toys-to-life series was shut down - and there's now footage of it in action.

Disney, Pixar, Marvel and Star Wars characters were set to cross over once again in the unannounced sequel, subtitled "Kingdoms", which would have featured a large world based on Aladdin's Agrabah.

Footage below, which surfaced on ResetEra, shows Aladdin and Yoda teaming up to solve puzzles and defeat enemies such as Jafar's snake.

notes.title: Disney Infinity 1.0: Gold Edition - Dec. 16th Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27118114/0ad881acd7aa22bfa96f5e88799a074cd79f9c9a.png[/img]

[b][u]Disney Infinity 1.0: Gold Edition - December 16, 2016 Update[/u][/b]
We are happy to have addressed some of the most requested changes.

Fixes Include:
- Game can now run in Offline Mode
- Fixed keyboard functionality in Main Menu
- Fixed minor UI issues in Tutorial Prompt

Thanks for being a Disney Infinity Fan.
